name: OneWeb Gen1 (Airbus Arrow)
note: Parity model for the v1.1 'LEO Broadband' type as flown by OneWeb (1200 km, 87.9 deg). Body frame: +Z nadir, +X velocity. A 1 x 1.3 x 1 m bus in MLI, two dish antennas below it, two arrays on yokes (5 m span) tracking the Sun about the cross-track axis. Benchmark: mallama2020b_oneweb (7.18 at 1000 km).
